attempt.client_observation: stat remote: No such file or directory
attempt.cause: The available OpenSSH sftp client implements put -a by requiring a stat-able remote partial target; it does not initialize an absent target.

decision: Reject recovery1 without editing it. Because the immutable control archive is only 13372 bytes, freeze a fresh recovery2 using one rate-limited ordinary SFTP put. Continue to require resumable SFTP for any large Mac-to-server artifact.
prohibited_actions: editing or deleting the v1 or recovery1 failure history
using either rejected remote logical path
generalizing ordinary put authorization to model weights or other large artifacts
